en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand historic opera house in a large open square. The building has richly ornamented Neo-Renaissance architecture with arched windows, heavy rusticated stone on the lower level, statues along the roofline, and a prominent portal crowned by a quadriga sculpture. Several people are walking or standing in the foreground and a few cars are visible in the distance. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
